text.id: Pluit, pagi. Rumah keluarga Sekar sepi kayak lagi nahan napas juga.
text.en: Pluit, morning. Sekar's family home is quiet, like it's holding its breath too.

text.en: Day 1 isn't written yet. The story continues in the next build.

summary.id: Raka sampai di Jakarta. Pencarian Sekar baru dimulai.
summary.en: Raka reaches Jakarta. The search for Sekar has only begun.
